verdict.rationale: Babylon.js docs confirm cross-platform export to desktop and mobile via Babylon Native and standard web/WebGL/WebGPU builds (babylonjs-docs-15, babylonjs-docs-32), but there is no evidence—first-party or community—of direct or partner-based console export support. missing for 10: console export capability (direct or via partner), any case study of a shipped console title, independent confirmation of Babylon Native's console reach.
